blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A medical graduate from Calapan City has topped the October 2026 Physician Licensure Examination (PLE). Dr. Maxine Francesco Gwyneth Cena Baculo topped the examination with a rating of 95.50 percent, according to results released by the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC). READ: PRC finally names 2026 Physicians Licensure Examination topnotcher Baculo was valedictorian of the University of Santo Tomas (UST) Faculty of Medicine and Surgery Class of 2025, and was a recipient of the Rector’s Award for Academic Excellence. The October 2026 PLE recorded 4,165 passers out of 4,447 examinees, representing a passing rate of 93.66 percent, […]...
